verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS voice-AI platform that ships a CLI, MCP server and SDKs, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Self-hosting (bolna-docs-9), Indian data residency and the call-summary toggle are related privacy and configuration features, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
